description: This file defines an abstract base class for AI-powered image generation services, specifically tailored to process text frames into images. It provides a structured interface for subclasses to implement the actual image generation logic.

classes.name: ImageGenService
classes.description: An abstract base class for image generation services that convert text prompts into images using AI models. Subclasses must implement the run_image_gen method to define specific image generation behavior.

methods.name: AsyncGenerator[Frame,None] run_image_gen(self, prompt: str)
methods.description: Abstract method to generate images from text prompts. Must be implemented by subclasses to produce frames containing generated images.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Processes a frame; if it's a TextFrame, uses its text as a prompt for image generation, else passes it through.

ctags.name: process_frame
ctags.pattern: /^    async def process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection):$/

ctags.name: run_image_gen
ctags.pattern: /^    async def run_image_gen(self, prompt: str) -> AsyncGenerator[Frame, None]:$/
